The '''Prospector Limpet Controller''' launches limpets that scan an asteroid and reveal its mineral composition, deposit information, and yield potential before a Commander commits to mining it.

== Overview ==

Prospector limpets are one of the original Limpet Controller types and are considered essential for efficient mining: without one, a Commander is mining asteroids blind, with no way to tell a rich deposit from a low-value one before spending time and ammunition on it. A Prospector scan is normally paired with a [[Collector Limpet Controller]] to retrieve whatever the mining process breaks loose.

== Mining role ==

Prospecting supports multiple methods:

* [[Laser Mining]] — choose asteroids worth spending laser time on.
* [[Core Mining]] — confirm contents before committing seismic charges.
* [[Sub-surface Mining]] — identify sub-surface deposits before using displacement missiles.
* [[Surface Deposit Mining]] — helps evaluate whether visible deposits are useful for the run.

Carry limpets in cargo. The controller provides the launch capability; limpets are the ammunition.
